question: Which of the following monuments was built by Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Charminar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah**, the fifth ruler of the Qutb Shahi dynasty, **founded the city of Hyderabad and built Charminar in 1591 AD**.
 
• It's a monument and mosque that has become synonymous with the history and heritage of Hyderabad.
 
• The monument was built to** commemorate the end of a deadly plague that had struck the city**.
 
• According to legends, Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah prayed for the end of the plague and took a vow to build a mosque at the very place where he prayed.
 
• Charminar is notable for its architecture, **a blend of Persian and Indian styles**.
 
• The structure is made of granite, limestone, and pulverized marble.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gol Gumbaz**

 
 
• **​**This **mausoleum of Sultan Mohamed Adil Shah**, Sultan of Bijapur.
 
• It was constructed by architect Yaqut of Dabul in the 17th century.
 
• It's famous for its massive dome and whispering gallery.
 
 
 
• **Chowmahalla Palace**
 
 
• **​**Chowmahalla Palace is a palace of the Nizams of Hyderabad State.
 
• It was the seat of the Asaf Jahi dynasty and was the **official residence of the Nizams of Hyderabad while they ruled their state**.
 
 
 
• **Warangal Fort**
 
 
• **​**Warangal Fort was **built in the 12th century by the Kakatiya king Ganapati Deva and his daughter Rani Rudrama Devi**.
 
• It's in Telangana and is noted for its four distinctive ornamental gates, still standing as testimony to the Kakatiya dynasty.
